string.name: trigger_ruleset_changed_reason
string.value: The desktop version hooks this trigger to the "ruleset state update" event. On HarmonyOS, rulesets are only evaluated in the panel, and there is no global state update event source — creating one would only cause the workflow to receive a large number of meaningless triggers.

string.name: trigger_signal_reason
string.value: The signal is sent by the v2 action classisland.broadcastSignal. HarmonyOS does not have v2 actions, so this signal will never be received.

string.name: trigger_tray_menu_reason
string.value: HarmonyOS has no tray, so running from the tray menu has no equivalent.

string.name: trigger_uri_reason
string.value: The HarmonyOS equivalent is the ability's want.uri (deep link), which requires declaring skills matching rules in module.json5 first — that step has not been done yet.
